summary: vspone_block output renames in hv_hur, hv_hur_facts, hv_ldev_facts, hv_resource_group_facts, hv_shadow_image_pair_facts and hv_snapshot_facts, mostly expanding pvol/svol into primary_volume/secondary_volume.
questions: What is pvol_status called now in hv_hur_facts?

answer_card.title: vspone_block output renames (part 3)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `hv_hur`: `storage_serial_number` → `primary_volume_storage_serial_number`, `secondary_storage_serial` → `secondary_volume_storage_serial_number`
- `hv_hur_facts`: `mirror_unit_id` → `mirror_unit_number`, journal pools → `primary/secondary_journal_id`, `pvol_status`/`svol_status` → `primary/secondary_volume_status`, storage serials → `primary/secondary_volume_storage_serial_number`
- `hv_ldev_facts`: `parity_group` → `parity_group_id`
- `hv_resource_group_facts`: same renames as `hv_resource_group`
- `hv_shadow_image_pair_facts` and `hv_snapshot_facts`: `mirror_unit_id` → `mirror_unit_number`; `pvol_*`/`svol_*` host groups, iSCSI targets and NVM subsystem names → `primary_volume_*`/`secondary_volume_*`
